args.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import random, time
lines=open('corpus.txt','rb').read().splitlines()
fixed=[b'the patient colony grew another spore',b'error compounds at the edges of the frozen core',b'selection keeps only what the assay can see',b'a model that cannot be measured cannot improve',b'the assay is the instrument, the instrument is the story',b'nothing on-chain, no token, no sale']
words=[b'assay', b'bound', b'core', b'error', b'kin', b'measure', b'spore']
rand=[]
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    text=l.split(b' ',1)[1].rsplit(b' ',1)[0]
    if text!=fixed[i%6]: rand.append((i,text.split()))
ri=[x[0] for x in rand[:20]]
rt=[x for x in rand[:5]]
print(ri, rt)
# brute seeds for algorithm random()<.15 then randint(3,9), choices
for thresh in [0.15,0.16,0.14,0.125,0.1]:
  t=time.time(); hits=[]
  for seed in range(20000):
    r=random.Random(seed); ok=True; k=0
    for i in range(200):
      if r.random()<thresh:
        L=r.randint(3,9); ws=[words[r.randrange(7)] for _ in range(L)]
        if k>=len(rand) or i!=rand[k][0] or ws!=rand[k][1]: ok=False; break
        k+=1
      else:
        if k<len(rand) and i==rand[k][0]: ok=False; break
    if ok:
      hits.append(seed); print('hit',thresh,seed); break
  print('thresh',thresh,'done',time.time()-t,hits[:5])
PY
